patterns: what do you do in dragon boating
facts.answer: Dragon boating is a team paddling sport. A crew paddles one long boat together, usually to a drummer’s rhythm. Beginners are welcome at YRD.

patterns: i don't know how to swim
facts.answer: We provide a PFD (life jacket). Tell the crew before attending if you can't swim so they can discuss water safety and whether participation is suitable.
Get a Dragon Pass online. Your first month is free.

patterns: do i need to register first
facts.answer: Please register for a Dragon Pass before attending, and confirm your first-session arrival and induction arrangements with the crew.

patterns: do i need a life jacket
facts.answer: Wear clothes and shoes that can get wet. Bring water, a towel and sun protection. We provide the paddle and PFD.
We train at the Community Boating Hub @ the Dock, 912 Collins Street, Docklands.
Check TeamApp or the Join page for the next training session. Contact the crew to confirm your first-session arrival and induction details.

patterns: do i need to be fit
facts.answer: Yes, beginners are welcome. You don’t need paddling experience.
Your Dragon Pass gives you a free first month. Paid membership options and current fees are shown in the registration portal; prices vary by category.
Trams 11 and 48 stop nearby at D18, Victoria Harbour. Parking is available around the Hub and near Woolworths on Seafarers Lane.

patterns: can i subscribe to the calendar
facts.answer: For club training, check the Join page and TeamApp. Dragon Boat Victoria's regatta calendar is linked from our Membership page, but YRD does not attend every event.
Yes. The Hub has toilets, change rooms, showers and lockers/storage.
Tell the crew about any injury, medical condition or accessibility need before training. We’ll work out what is suitable with you.
